title: Emotional awareness with agents
body_markdown:
Struggling to decipher emails? Not sure what emotions your boss is conveying? You're not alone.


In fast-paced teams, clarity and emotional intelligence aren’t just nice-to-haves, they’re mission-critical.


In[this short video](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7328908579170643969) , we demo our **e-mail EQ Helper** , one of Wordware’s newest[autonomous agents](https://blog.wordware.ai/best-ai-agent-frameworks-for-developing-autonomous-systems) . It helps you respond to difficult messages, internally or externally, with emotional precision and clarity.


Whether you're answering a tense client email, pushing back on a timeline, or navigating a sensitive teammate request, EQ Helper helps you:


-


Understand the tone and meaning of emails you receive


-


Draft emotionally intelligent responses


-


Reframe messages without losing intent


-


Communicate with confidence and empathy


Built inside **Wordware** , EQ Helper is just one of many agents designed to automate the work between your tools, teams, and tasks.
